benchmark.scope: Local Android app_process CPU rendering, not Activity/display FPS. New run used the independently built APK without a classes override.
benchmark.setup_cost: One initial render plus three setup probes per decoded size; parsed SVG/probes released afterward.
benchmark.accuracy_scope: Mean RGB error is over the whole canvas; maximum is any sampled pixel channel. Four sampled times only.

limitations: Mixed indexed-paint edges/overlaps use a raster approximation; initial frame is exact, later RGB metrics cover four sampled times only.
Tagged animated gradient stops retain vector fallback and can still be slow.
Raster setup increases one-time decode cost.
Display FPS, visible UI/touch/video/audio acceptance not established by headless probes.
Infinikey unchanged and not rerun; Ubuntu and other-platform work deferred.
additional_regression: Native still-preview parity caught a difference in the generic static IFF route. Non-SVG still decoding now retains the established viewer first-frame pixels before dropping playback state; IFF/BMP pixel equality passed.
